summary: Acer Aspire 5 15 (Model: A515-57GQ) is experiencing thermal throttling issues due to inadequate cooling. The laptop's Intel Core i3-12100H processor, 8GB DDR4 RAM, and 256GB NVMe SSD are affected.
detected_fault: Inadequate cooling system leading to thermal throttling
suggested_solution: Use a cooling pad or external fan to maintain optimal temperatures
